description: This PHP class Maps extends AcceptanceTester and provides methods for creating maps within acceptance tests. It interacts with various UI elements such as sidebars, forms, and list views to automate the creation of map records.

classes.name: Maps
classes.description: A class used in acceptance testing for creating map records within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: createMap
methods.description: Creates a new map record by filling out form fields and interacting with the UI elements in the acceptance test environment.
